title: Define mandatory zero-cost execution inventory
objective: Define a deterministic static cost auditor for every mandatory Development Engine workflow and governance cost policy, proving the path contains no paid API, paid LLM, paid SaaS, paid license dependency, self-hosted/larger runner requirement, or hidden paid secret while deferring live public-repository visibility qualification to WU02.
non_goals: query billing APIs or account balances
change GitHub plan or repository visibility
modify mandatory workflows except removal of completed ENG-08.3 qualification-only hooks
infer public-repository pricing without runtime evidence

required_invariants: canonical project cost_policy keeps paid_external_api_required paid_llm_required paid_runner_required and paid_saas_required false
mandatory engine workflow set is explicit and bounded rather than all historical lot workflows
every mandatory workflow uses only explicitly allowed standard runner labels
self-hosted larger-runner and paid-runner markers are forbidden
cloud LLM provider secrets paid license secrets and paid SaaS credentials are forbidden on the mandatory path
every third-party action used by mandatory workflows must be present in the approved action pin registry and in an explicit zero-cost action allowlist
governance policies for secrets dependencies SAST workflow security supply chain and complete security engine must each declare a zero-paid-cost path
WU01 reports repository visibility as UNVERIFIED rather than assuming GitHub-hosted runner cost
no network billing query paid service or external cache is required
acceptance_criteria: static auditor inventories the complete mandatory workflow set and all uses/runs-on declarations
all mandatory workflows use standard allowed runners only
no forbidden paid credential/provider marker is present
all mandatory action repositories are explicitly classified zero-cost
all referenced governance cost policies declare no paid requirement
project cost policy remains all false
static result is PASS_WITH_VISIBILITY_UNVERIFIED rather than an unsupported total-cost claim
WU02 can bind repository.public evidence and adversarially qualify failure scenarios

done_when: mandatory Development Engine workflows and governance cost policies have a deterministic static inventory
all paid-provider runner license and SaaS dependencies fail closed
static zero-cost evidence is honest about unresolved repository visibility
WU02 can qualify public-repository zero-cost execution without changing workflows
